what_this_is: What every locally-hosted published image IS. This is NOT a rights file: image-rights-records.json governs whether PlotNua may publish someone else's image, and this governs what PlotNua's own published images are. A SUPPLIER_IMAGE row here carries a pointer (rights_ref) to that file and duplicates none of it. Nothing in this file grants any permission.

asset_classes.SUPPLIER_IMAGE: Actual supplier imagery, published under a documented permission or a valid licence. Carries rights_ref pointing at the authorising organisation row in image-rights-records.json.
asset_classes.AI_ILLUSTRATION: Independently generated generic imagery that reproduces no supplier photograph and no distinctive product design. Carries the tool, the date, the prompt, an explicit reference_inputs list and a named human review.
asset_classes.FOUNDER_ORIGINAL_ARTWORK: A photograph of an original artwork created and owned by PlotNua's founder. Not AI-generated, not supplier imagery. Carries the artwork's creator and owner, the photograph and its processing, the photographer (or NOT YET CONFIRMED), the visible credit and the founder's attestation.

the_third_state.name: NO_IMAGE
the_third_state.note: NO_IMAGE is the state of an image SLOT that has no asset. It is deliberately NOT a class in this register, because a register of assets cannot hold a record for an image that does not exist. It is recorded here so the distinction is explicit: every image slot on a published page resolves to exactly one of three states, two of which point at a record in this file and the third of which points at nothing. NO_IMAGE must stay as easy to choose as the other two -- if it is not a respectable answer, the pressure is always to fill the slot with something, and that pressure is how laundering starts.

rules: Never use AI to launder a copyrighted image.
AI generation is never evidence of rights. No code path reads this file to answer a rights question.
Never imply an AI illustration depicts a named supplier's actual product.
An absent term is never an inclusion: an asset with no record is undeclared, not cleared.
AI illustrations do not appear on individual supplier product cards. product-card is not an available permitted surface.
Provenance is never inferred from appearance.

One founder-attested exception (PN-FDR-2026-10-23-GRP-HERO): the six Garden Room Prices hero files, whose exact prompt is unavailable, carry prompt_status UNAVAILABLE, a reference_disclosure (UNCERTAIN) and a resemblance_review instead of a prompt and reference_inputs. It is pinned to those files by SHA-256 in validate-image-provenance.js and is not a way to declare images: every new AI illustration records its prompt verbatim at creation.

recovery.instructed_by: Founder policy implementation, 11 October 2026, item 2: recover evidence wherever possible, do not invent missing information.
searched: embedded metadata on all 110 deployed assets
every path ever added or deleted across all git branches, for generation scripts, prompts and source manifests
the master image library outside the repository
embedded metadata on the matched masters
the git commit that introduced each asset
recovery.conclusion: Provenance CONTEXT was recovered for 77 of 110 assets: which picture each one is, which Discovery it served, and the commit and date that introduced it. Provenance CLASSIFICATION was recovered for NONE. No deployed image carries any evidence of what made it, so no image is declared. Nine masters in the library DO carry iOS device evidence and are therefore photographs, but not one of them is among the assets that shipped.
recovery.a_fourth_class_may_be_needed: Those nine masters are photographs taken by PlotNua. They are neither a supplier's image nor an AI illustration, so the approved three-state taxonomy has no place for a first-party photograph. None of them is published today, so nothing is blocked -- but the first one to be published will need a founder decision rather than a guess. Recorded here rather than resolved, because inventing a class was not authorised.

how_to_declare_an_asset: 1. Establish what made the image, from real knowledge. If that is not available, do not declare it.
2. Move its entry from legacy_undeclared to records, keeping the asset path and recomputing sha256.

3. For AI_ILLUSTRATION: record tool, date, prompt verbatim, an explicit reference_inputs array (empty is an assertion, absent is an unanswered question), depicts_named_product false, depicts_named_organisation false, a named human_review, and permitted_surfaces.
4. For SUPPLIER_IMAGE: record rights_ref only. Copy no permission data.
6. Only once records exist may the corresponding page captions be labelled.
label_note: An undeclared asset gets NO label. Inventing a classification to fill a caption is the error this register exists to prevent, and no published caption changes until the matching record exists.
legacy_undeclared_note: THE RATCHET. Every asset below is enumerated by path and sha256. The guard refuses any local image on a published page that is in neither records nor this list, so no NEW undeclared image can be added. The count is printed on every CI run and only ever goes down. A legacy entry is NOT a declaration, is NOT verified, is NOT authorised supplier imagery, and may not reach a product card or a supplier context.

resemblance_review.compared_against: The licensed supplier photographs carried in the live Garden Retreat composite (possibility-reveal-L6: the supplier's cube sauna with a lit full-height glass front, and its wood-fired hot tub with an internal snorkel stove); board: retreat-resemblance-board.png
findings: Shares only generic features of the category: a timber sauna cabin, a round timber hot tub, a stove chimney with steam
Sauna form differs: a tall, narrow, light vertical-board cabin with one narrow upright window, not a wide dark-clad cube with a full-height glass front
Hot tub differs: an external free-standing black stove beside the tub, not the supplier's internal snorkel stove in the water; plain vertical staves with no visible bands
Setting and composition differ: evening planting bed and fence corner at the far right of a lawn, not a paved terrace with stepping stones and a red maple
resemblance_review.verdict: No distinctive design element of the compared supplier products is reproduced. The features shared (a timber sauna cabin, a round timber hot tub, a stove flue) are generic to the category.

possibility_reveal_lock_chain.what_this_is: THE AUTHORITATIVE POSSIBILITY REVEAL LOCK CHAIN, mirrored here from ACTIVE-LOCKS.json in the lock repository (commit 139d530, H5C4-S lock: the Garden Retreat with the licensed TimberIN Nordic Cube sauna, 22 Oct 2026; earlier: H5C4 ba62bc0, L6 6b8741f, L3 v2.1c b2ca5da). It names which locked version of each layer is ACTIVE. Builds of any Reveal image must start from active_master; superseded versions are kept for provenance and rollback only. P13 refuses a staged or published composite that is not on this chain, a chain that does not name the active L3 (H5C4) by hash, and a chain that applies or activates a superseded L3 (v2, v2.1c). atlas-tools/verify-possibility-reveal-locks.py checks this block against the lock repository and rebuilds the master pixel-identically.
possibility_reveal_lock_chain.lock_repository: possibility-reveal-locks (offline; bundles in the LOCKED folders on the founder's Mac). HEAD 139d530 (H5C4-S lock, 22 Oct 2026).

chain.step: L1 + L2A + L3 v2 + L4 + L5 (as locked 18 Oct)
+ L3 H5C4 (replaces the L3 v2 pixels in the L5 master; supersedes v2.1c)
+ L6 H5C4-S (the H5C4 retreat with the licensed TimberIN Nordic Cube sauna; replaces L6 H5C4 public)

locked_layers_in_base.note: Locked layers that the active chain carries inside its base (the L5 master) rather than in active_layers. Not part of the ACTIVE-LOCKS.json mirror; recorded so a published L4 tile can be checked against its lock.

l6_solo_without_L3.note: Not part of the ACTIVE-LOCKS.json mirror. The L6 H5C4-S render without the pavilion (shown with L3 off); built by h5c4lock/tools/build_h5c4.py (private variant) in the same run as the L6 H5C4-S layer and promoted with it; identical to the L6 layer outside the pavilion.
l6_solo_without_L3.method: h5c4lock/tools/build_h5c4.py: the same deterministic render as the L6 H5C4-S layer, with the L3 H5C4 pavilion switched off; identical to the locked L6 H5C4-S layer outside the pavilion

staged_composites_note: STAGED COMPOSITES (H2, 20 Oct 2026). A locked composite whose provenance is recorded before publication. It names no asset, so nothing on a page can be accounted for by it. Checked by P6 and P13. It grants nothing: the permission lives in image-adaptation-licences.json, reached only through rights_ref (organisation_code + atlas_permission_ref), exactly as P4 reaches the rights manifest.

staged_composites.composition: MIXED: AI-assisted illustration (house, garden, pavilion, pod) with photographic elements (the hot tub, its chimney smoke and the Nordic Cube sauna are TimberIN photographs, adapted under written permission) and PlotNua drawings (terrace, cold plunge, stepping stones, lights, maple stems; planting and stone cut from this illustration itself; Japanese-maple foliage from an Unsplash-licensed photograph). Not a photograph of a real garden; the hot tub and the sauna are real TimberIN products as photographed by TimberIN.

generated.tool: AI-assisted layers: OpenAI ChatGPT image generation and Google Gemini image editing, as declared per layer in the nine Possibility Reveal records and in the L1-L5 lock records. Photographic elements (TimberIN hot tub and smoke): no generative model; carried unchanged from the L6 TimberIN lock (l6lock/tools). H5C4 retreat and the Nordic Cube sauna: no generative model; PlotNua deterministic drawing, re-projection and compositing, h5c4lock/tools/build_h5c4.py (sauna variant promoted unchanged as h5c4slock).

staged_composites.prompt: Composite record. The generative prompts are recorded per layer: L1 and L2A in the nine Possibility Reveal records (prompt_chain), L3-L6 in their lock records. No generative model was used for the licensed photographic elements, and no prompt for any layer names a supplier, organisation or product.

licensed_photographic_elements.element: the hot tub, with its flue pipe, collar and hooded cap
licensed_photographic_elements.treatment: every tub pixel is a photographed pixel, re-projected from Photograph A's recovered camera into the garden camera; graded to the evening light; contact and cast shadow; not mirrored; design unchanged. Excluded: the hillside background and its watermark, the wooden prop and base plate.

smoke matte separated from the foliage behind it; mirrored, scale 0.42, 6 degree lean, opacity 0.88, desaturated and lit to the scene; placed above the cap of the Photograph A chimney. Nothing drawn. Excluded: everything else in Photograph B.

the sauna's photographed faces re-projected from the photograph into the garden camera (perspective and size, at its published dimensions) and lit to the scene, standing on the charcoal terrace beside the Garden Room in the founder-approved Option C position; contact and cast shadow; design unchanged. Excluded: the photograph's background.

brand_vector_derivatives_note: BRAND VECTOR DERIVATIVES (22 Oct 2026, founder-approved Atlas symbol C). Each entry is a pure vector redrawn from brand artwork this register already holds, bound to each source's exact sha256. It inherits its sources' provenance state (both sources are LEGACY_UNDECLARED, so this is NOT a declaration and NOT verified), carries no class, label or rights field, and is not counted in legacy_undeclared, so the ratchet is unchanged. The guard (P14) refuses one whose source changed, whose source is not brand artwork, that embeds or links any image or external resource, that records no founder approval, or that no page shows.
